overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to conduct routine business including financial reports, consent agenda items, and new business matters spanning zoning and land use decisions, park facilities planning, and municipal infrastructure projects.

agenda.item: Call meeting to order with Pledge of Allegiance and Roll Call
Public comment (15 minutes total, three minutes per person)
July 13, 2026 Village Board Meeting Minutes (consent agenda)
June 2026 Check Register, ACH Register, and Credit Card Transactions Activity (consent agenda)
CSM Happy Hollow Road - Dean Prohaska
September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser Event
Wausau & Marathon County Parks & Recreation Foundation Grant
Consideration of items for future agenda

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to review the timetable for preparation and adoption of the 2027 municipal budget. This item was set to inform the Board of key dates and deadlines for the budget development process.
The Board was set to consider the schedule for property revaluation activities spanning 2026 and 2027. This was expected to outline the timeline for Marathon County's reassessment process.

The Board was scheduled to review the mid-year budget status report and financial statements as of June 30, 2026. This item was set to provide oversight of municipal finances for the first half of the fiscal year.

discussions.item: CSM Happy Hollow Road - Dean Prohaska
discussions.body: The Board was expected to consider a Certified Survey Map for Happy Hollow Road submitted by Dean Prohaska, referred from the Plan Commission. This item was set for discussion and possible action on the land survey matter.

The Board was scheduled to consider a rezoning request for the Marathon County Highway Facility, a matter referred from the Plan Commission. This item was set for discussion and possible action on the zoning change.

The Board was set to consider a Certified Survey Map for the Marathon County Highway Facility, referred from the Plan Commission. This item was scheduled for discussion and possible action on the survey documentation.

The Board was expected to consider proposed amendments or provisions related to septic tank regulations, a matter referred from the Plan Commission. This item was set for discussion and possible action on local septic system standards.

The Board was scheduled to address twin home and zero lot line development standards, a matter referred from the Plan Commission. This item was set for discussion and possible action on residential development regulations.

discussions.item: September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser Event
discussions.body: The Board was set to consider approval or discussion of a 5K run/walk fundraiser event scheduled for September 12, 2026 at Buska Park, referred from the Parks Committee. This item was expected to address event permits and municipal support.

discussions.item: Wausau & Marathon County Parks & Recreation Foundation Grant
discussions.body: The Board was expected to consider a grant opportunity or application from the Wausau & Marathon County Parks & Recreation Foundation, referred from the Parks Committee. This item was set for discussion of potential funding for village parks or recreation initiatives.

The Board was scheduled to consider a budget adjustment for municipal garage bathroom improvements or repairs, referred from the APC. This item was set for discussion and possible action on the expenditure authorization.
The Board was set to consider a bike path sealing project, referred from the APC. This item was scheduled for discussion of the maintenance or improvement work needed on village bike paths.

The Board was expected to consider a budget adjustment related to bike path sealing expenses, referred from the APC. This item was set for discussion and possible action on funding authorization for the sealing project.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, with a 15-minute total period and three minutes per person, at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion for extensions.
